home.preparingBody: Soon: carefully designed digital invitations for your occasions.

errors.notFoundBody: The link may have changed or is no longer available.

login.heading: Sign in
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
login.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

verify.heading: Two-step verification
verify.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
verify.invalid: The code is incorrect or was already used.
verify.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes.
verify.recoveryUsed: A recovery code was used. You now have fewer codes left; the owner can reset your two-step verification to issue new ones.

setup2fa.heading: Turn on two-step verification
setup2fa.intro: Two-step verification is required for every admin account. Scan the code with an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the code it shows.
setup2fa.invalid: Incorrect code. Check that your phone's clock is correct and try again.
setup2fa.recoveryIntro: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

password.heading: Change password
password.mustChange: You must replace your temporary password before continuing.
password.saved: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
password.sameAsCurrent: The new password must be different from the current one.
password.tooShort: The password must be at least 12 characters.
password.tooSimple: The password is too simple; use a wider mix of characters.
password.containsEmail: The password must not contain your email.

dashboard.intro: This is the first stage of the admin panel: accounts, roles and audit history. The other sections will be added next.

users.heading: Users & roles
users.name: Name
users.created: Account created. Temporary password (shown only once):
users.createdHint: Send it to the user securely. They must change it and turn on two-step verification at first sign-in.
users.confirm: Are you sure? This action is recorded in the audit history.

errors.emailTaken: This email is already in use.
errors.lastOwner: The last active owner cannot be removed or disabled.
errors.self: You can't perform this action on your own account.

audit.heading: Audit history
audit.intro: A tamper-resistant record of every important action.

forbidden.heading: You don't have access
forbidden.body: Ask the owner to grant you the right permission.

common.reason: Reason (optional, saved in the audit history)
common.confirm: Are you sure? This action is recorded.
common.kurdishHint: Kurdish fields are optional; if empty, visitors see the Arabic text.

sections.heading: Sections
sections.intro: The occasions shown on the website. Archiving hides a section from visitors without affecting purchased invitations.
sections.keyHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. wedding. Cannot be changed later.
sections.name: Name
sections.requiredFeaturesHint: Every package in this section must include these (e.g. the printable card for weddings).
sections.defaultFieldsHint: New themes in this section inherit these fields and labels.

fields.heading: Field library
fields.intro: The standard fields customers fill in. You can edit labels and length limits; adding a new field needs a code update because themes render it.
fields.label: Default label

music.heading: Music library
music.intro: Songs assigned to themes. Each theme has one song, and the same file is never stored twice.
music.title: Song title
music.fileHint: MP3 only, up to 15 MB and 10 minutes.
music.rightsHint: Only use music you have the right to use.

themes.heading: Themes
themes.intro: A new theme starts in development and is invisible to customers until you activate it.
themes.synced: Synced: {themes} new themes, {versions} new versions, {updated} updated versions.
themes.conflicts: Warning: activated versions changed in code and the change was NOT applied: {refs}
themes.name: Theme name
themes.cover: Cover image (shown on the theme card)
themes.versionsHint: Every invitation stays on the version it was bought with. Changing the current version only affects new purchases.
themes.fieldsHint: The theme code defines its fields. You can change their order and labels for this theme only.
themes.packagesHint: 1 to 3 packages. Each package matches a state the designer created; the top package is the complete theme.
themes.stateHint: Choose one of the states the theme was designed for.
themes.stateMissing: Unavailable: missing {features}, required in this section.
themes.confirmActivate: The theme will be visible to customers and its current version will be frozen. Continue?
themes.confirmArchiveActive: The theme will disappear from the website and can no longer be bought. Existing invitations are not affected. Continue?
themes.previewLater: Live preview arrives with the theme engine (milestone 3).

problems.versionNotInBuild: The current version's code is not deployed.
problems.packageInvalid: A package doesn't match any designed state
problems.packageMissingRequired: A package is missing a feature required by the section
problems.noMusic: A package includes music but no song is chosen.

themes.priceUsdHint: You set both prices. The USD price is optional for now and will be used once card payments (Mastercard) are enabled.

errors.invalidAsset: This file can't be used here.
errors.duplicateTrack: This file is already in the library as:
errors.musicInUse: This song is used by themes; change them first:
errors.noVersion: The theme has no current version.
errors.notValidState: This combination doesn't match any designed state.
errors.missingRequiredFeature: Missing a feature required by this section:
errors.tooManyPackages: A theme can't have more than 3 active packages.
errors.wouldBreakTheme: This change would leave the theme incomplete:
errors.invalidTransition: That status change isn't allowed directly.
errors.internalTheme: The demo theme can never be put on sale.
errors.packagesInvalidForVersion: Packages that don't fit this version:
errors.fieldSetMismatch: The fields don't match the theme.
errors.unsupportedImage: Unsupported image format (use JPG, PNG or WebP).
errors.unsupportedAudio: The file is not a valid MP3.
errors.imageTooSmall: The image is too small (minimum 200 px).
errors.audioTooLong: The song is longer than 10 minutes.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended; please sign in again.
